data.one_liner: Chopper interceptor that logs network calls in a pretty and readable format.
data.what_it_does: Pretty Chopper logger is a Chopper interceptor designed to enhance network call logging in Dart applications. It provides visually appealing and formatted outputs for requests and responses, with support for multiple log levels, JSON pretty-printing, and customizable border widths and indentation.
use_when: You are using the Chopper HTTP client in your Flutter or Dart project and need readable network logs.
You want to customize logging levels (headers, body, basic) and formatting for API requests and responses.
avoid_when: You are using a different HTTP client such as Dio or standard http package without Chopper.
You require advanced remote logging or crash reporting integrations rather than console formatting.
strengths: Clean and readable network call logs with automatic JSON formatting.
Customizable log levels, max width, and indentation sizes.
Easy setup as a standard Chopper interceptor.
weaknesses: Limited specifically to the Chopper HTTP client ecosystem.
Outputs only to the console (development tool).
data.setup_notes: Add the package to pubspec.yaml and pass PrettyChopperLogger into your ChopperClient interceptors list.

alternatives.name: pretty_dio_logger
alternatives.why_pick_it: If you are using Dio instead of Chopper for your network requests.

alternatives.name: talker
alternatives.why_pick_it: If you want a more comprehensive logging and error-handling package for Flutter applications.
